GATES.name: Distinct scientific prediction vis-a-vis strongest already published designs
GATES.evidence: Kloc 2024 leaderboard offer, Lovasz 2023 factorial, Zou Gao 2023 public welfare, Adjodah 2021 social accuracy-risk, Witkowski proper rank incentive, Agranov 2026 public signal plus action visibility, Xu 2026 randomized comparator group. Joint PFL-specific interactions possible but not validated as novel.

GATES.name: Exact original data file identity, version and license
GATES.evidence: Caltech supplement is PDF copyrighted Elsevier; NBER data appendix not fetched. AEA Xu package title displayed but exact DOI/README and LICENSE not inspected.

GATES.name: Competent processing rights, human privacy/ethics
GATES.evidence: Original experimental and administrative individual data were not downloaded; original ethics approval does not grant PFL reuse. AEA policy permits confidential data exceptions.

GATES.name: Complete assigned roster and all zero-response opportunities
GATES.evidence: No original files of all randomized registrants and full question timeline. Published analyzed N != total assigned.

GATES.name: Independent pre-response exposure, treatment and spillover mapping
GATES.evidence: Published treatments are conceptual descriptions, not independent event logs with as-of room exposure per person, incl nonresponders.

GATES.name: Strong control, prospective outcome and confirmation sample
GATES.evidence: Precommitted cross-product R(public/private rank) × A(actions shown/hidden) with raw signals and benchmark forecasting score still a conditional plan. No frozen executable instrument, sample or independent new question holdout.

allowed_non_personal_next_actions: Locate verified official dataset DOI and README / LICENSE for Xu 2026, inspect only metadata and experiment program without participant rows.

Check NBER public data appendix metadata (link presently fails), original registration AEARCTR-0003315 and nonparticipant codebook for Agranov 2026, without downloading individuals or accepting terms.
Compare planned interaction R×A against experiment methods of Agranov 2026, Kloc 2024 and Chen 2023 and define one discriminating estimand not reducible to their hypotheses.

If authorized prospective pilot becomes feasible, perform prior ethics/privacy assessment, recruitment authority and full assignment/exposure instrumentation, with frozen baseline and researcher-graded harms and retention.
do_not_do: Do not open an A–J run solely for four documentary references or code schema tests
Do not infer actual personal-data rights from article license
Do not claim replication from paper findings alone
Do not merge PR to main or launch costly CI
Do not score public political figures or collect PII
decision: No experimental code was frozen or run because eligible empirical source + rights + truly discriminant estimand were not established. New C05 slot remains unspent. Historical 2 slots unspent and governed by separate gate.
